Ordering

How do I place an order?+

Choose a product, pick your colour and size, then tap Buy on WhatsApp. The chat opens with your order details filled in — press send and we'll confirm stock, delivery charges and payment.

Can I order several products at once?+

Yes. Tap Add to Bag on each item, open the bag from the top of the page and tap Send Order on WhatsApp. Your whole list and total go in one message.

Do I need to create an account?+

No account is needed. Everything is handled over WhatsApp.

Is the price on the website final?+

Product prices include taxes. Delivery charges depend on your location and order size, and we'll confirm them before you pay.

Custom teamwear

Can you add names, numbers and logos?+

Yes — player names, numbers, team crests and sponsor logos. Send your logo on WhatsApp (PNG, PDF or a clear photo is fine) and a list of names, numbers and sizes.

Is there a minimum order quantity?+

Names and numbers can be added to single jerseys. Fully custom designs are priced by quantity — with your team size.

Will I see the design before it's printed?+

Always. We send a digital mockup for your approval, and production only starts once you're happy with it.

How long do custom orders take?+

It depends on quantity and design. We'll give you a delivery date when you approve the mockup — tell us early if you have a tournament deadline.

Shipping & delivery

Do you deliver across India?+

Yes, we ship pan-India through trusted courier partners.

How long does delivery take?+

Ready-stock items are usually dispatched within 1–2 working days. Delivery typically takes 3–7 working days after dispatch, depending on your location. See our shipping policy.

How can I track my order?+

We send the courier tracking number on WhatsApp as soon as your parcel is dispatched.

Returns & exchanges

Can I exchange for a different size?+

Yes — unused ready-stock items with tags and original packaging can be exchanged within 7 days of delivery. Message us on WhatsApp to arrange it.

Can I return personalised items?+

Items with names, numbers or logos are made just for you, so they can't be returned — unless they arrive damaged or different from the approved design.

What if my item arrives damaged?+

Send us photos on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery and we'll replace it or refund you. Full details are in our returns policy.

Payments

Which payment methods do you accept?+

UPI and bank transfer. Available options are confirmed on WhatsApp when we finalise your order.

Do custom orders need an advance?+

Custom orders are confirmed with an advance payment once you approve the mockup. We'll share the exact amount with your quote.
